d: Chhath Puja is Bihar's major festival where devotees pay homage to the Sun God, engaging in prayers and fasting rituals that span over four days. The significance of this festival is marked by various customs, including sacred dips in holy rivers and offerings made to the rising and setting sun known as 'arghya.' The fasting and most of the rituals are done by womenfolk. The first day of Chhat Puja is called Nahay Khay.
